topic_search_intent.rationale: Covers promised types, sizes, materials, printing

semantic_information_value.rationale: Good topical breadth; format taxonomy overlap

practical_decision_support.rationale: Some sizes useful, compatibility workflow missing

b2b_commercial_relevance.rationale: High relevance to sellers and shipping teams

executive_summary.strengths: Useful format and sizes table, addresses common printer workflows, and covers material selection and label application.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Confuses roll and sheet formats, overgeneralizes thermal/laser moisture resistance, has visible proofreading errors, and presents unfounded universal claims about printers and adhesive.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Separate sheet/roll form factors and direct thermal/thermal transfer; qualify water resistance as substrate/ink-dependent; proofread language and validate device-specific label compatibility.
